name: Groddoc Liver
summary: Groddoc Liver comes from the apes of Feralas. Rhapsody Shindigger needs it for a drink he hopes will loosen his tongue about a frightening flight over a swamp.

sections.title: A Bitter Ingredient
sections.body: Rhapsody Shindigger asks for Groddoc Liver in the Hinterlands, along with Roc Gizzards and Ironfur Livers. He plans to distill the three ingredients into a Kalimdor Kocktail. The drink, he says, may help him speak of the horrors of a flight over a swamp.

faq.q: Where do Groddoc Livers come from?
faq.answer: Groddoc Livers come from Groddoc Apes in Feralas.
Rhapsody Shindigger in the Hinterlands asks for three Groddoc Livers to make his Kalimdor Kocktail.

faq.q: What is Groddoc Liver used for?
faq.answer: Rhapsody Shindigger uses Groddoc Liver with Roc Gizzards and Ironfur Livers for a Kalimdor Kocktail.

faq.q: Why is Rhapsody making the drink?
faq.answer: Rhapsody says he needs a stronger drink before he can tell you about a frightening flight over a swamp.
